subject: Post-demo compliance summary — audit logs, SOC 2 scope & next actions
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@fincore.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.inference.com
Cc: lena.morris@fincore.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — compliance items and priorities

Priya,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier — the demo was helpful. Wanted to capture the compliance-related items we flagged so we can line up internal stakeholders and make a decision quickly. High-level pain/goals from our side: 

- Audit log availability and retention: we need append-only audit logs, retention options for 1/3/7 years, and an easy export process for forensic requests.
- SOC 2: we will need your SOC 2 report (Type II) and description of in-scope services.
- DPA and data residency: template DPA with standard EU/US clauses; we may need a slight retention carve-out for regs.
- Pen test windows: we run annual pen tests and need to coordinate a vendor-friendly window + remediation SLA.

Next asks from Fincore: can you share a short artifact list (SOC 2 report, retention matrix, sample audit-log export) and propose a security-only sync with your InfoSec team next week? Attached is a short requirements spreadsheet so you can match fields.

Attachments: Fincore_requirements.xlsx (application requirements, spreadsheet)

Also looping in Lena for legal coordination on DPAs.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, IT Risk
Fincore Capital

---

Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — compliance items and priorities

Samir — great to meet you and Lena today. Appreciate the clear ask list, and I captured the items below with proposed next steps. Please correct me if I missed anything.

Recap of pain & goals (your framing)
- Must: audit logs with tamper-evidence and export capability; retention policy choices (1/3/7 years) necessary for regulators.
- Must: access to latest SOC 2 Type II report and a statement of the Redwood service boundary.
- Nice-to-have: DPA template with retention options and a straightforward amendment process.
- Operational: co-ordinated pen test windows and an agreed notification/remediation SLA.

What Redwood will do (next actions)
1) Share SOC 2 summary + what is in/out of scope (Irene to own). Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (short summary).
2) Provide an audit-log retention matrix showing export formats and APIs (attached: auditlog-retention-matrix.csv).
3) Set up a 30-minute security sync between your InfoSec and our Infosec (Irene) — propose: Thu 5/21 10:00–10:30 PT.
4) Legal: provide DPA draft and a sample redline process; we’ll share initial DPA and an editable DocuSign link after the security sync (Marissa to coordinate legal touchpoints).

Approx timeline: provide SOC2 summary and retention matrix by EOD Wed 5/20; security sync Thu 5/21; DPA draft within 48 hours of the sync.

Questions for you before the sync:
- Which retention horizon is highest priority (1/3/7)?
- Do you have an internal pen-test vendor or do you expect to run ours/third-party?

CC’ing Irene (Infosec) and Marissa (CS/legal) to pick up artifact delivery and coordination.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- SOC 2 Type II summary + scope doc: Irene to own (deliverable: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf).
- Audit-log retention matrix + example export: Irene to own (deliverable: auditlog-retention-matrix.csv).
- DPA draft and high-level redline notes: Marissa to own (Marissa, we can start with our standard DPA and add retention options).
- Pen-test coordination: Irene to confirm available windows and remediation SLA language.

Marissa — if you can draft a short legal summary of the standard DPA carve-outs we typically accept and one-line examples of what requires escalation to legal ops, that will speed Fincore’s review.

I’ll aim to send Samir the SOC2 summary + retention matrix by EOD Wed 5/20 and propose Thu 5/21 10:00 PT for the security sync.

Thanks,
Priya

Priya — thanks for the quick follow-up and the clear owners. Thu 5/21 10:00 PT works for us for a short security sync — confirming attendees: me (IT Risk), Lena (Legal), and our security engineer, Victor (victor@fincore.com).

Priority answers for your questions:
- Retention horizon: 3 years is our starting requirement, but we need the option to extend to 7 for specific regulated product lines.
- Pen test: we use an external vendor (Coastline Security). We will need a window in July (any two-week window) and expect a 30-day remediation SLA for critical/high findings.

Attached a consolidated vendor requirements PDF so you can pre-check non-functional asks. Also, please share the DPA draft after the security sync — Lena will coordinate with our counsel.

Attachments: Fincore_vendor_requirements.pdf (PDF)

See you Thursday.

Best,
Samir
